name: claude-brain
description: Obsidian plugin: watch Claude Code work as live activity on a real MRI brain. Local only, uses no tokens.

scripts.build: node tools/prepare.mjs && bun build src/main.js --outfile dist/main.js --target=node --format=cjs --minify --external obsidian --external http --external zlib && cp manifest.json src/styles.css dist/
scripts.dev: node tools/prepare.mjs && bun build src/main.js --outfile dist/main.js --target=node --format=cjs --external obsidian --external http --external zlib --watch
